instructions: Candidate-visible evidence guidance for a non-selection engineering test. A human reviewer records concrete implementation and visible-test evidence, missing behavior and limitations. Do not infer ability beyond the work, assign a score or rank, recommend hiring, or claim selection validity.

criteria.observation: Identify the exported TypeScript comparison function and return type. Describe observed signed endpoint and area differences, line-ID matching and input preservation against TASK.md. Record missing or contrary evidence explicitly. Do not assess building-code expertise or pricing accuracy.

Identify visible automated tests demonstrating unchanged values, increases and decreases, reordered lines, one-decimal area differences and input preservation. Record their actual outcomes and any coverage gaps. Passing existing baseline tests alone does not establish that the requested comparison was implemented.
